subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II bridge + targeted authn/artifact slices
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@truhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: TruHealth Audit Team <audit@truhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 Type II: supplemental control artifact request

Mina —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of TruHealth's SOC 2 Type II review for Q3–Q4 2026 (audit ID: TRU-2026-88) we need the following supplemental artifacts in addition to your Type II report and bridge letter:

1) MFA enforcement logs (successful + failed MFA attempts) for the period 2026-06-01 to 2026-11-30. We only need a sampled slice but it must cover at least three consecutive business days and include token/session ids, user ids, timestamp, and outcome.

2) SAML assertion traces for federated logins for service accounts used by integrations (list will be provided separately) — show a handful of assertion IDs and timestamps, redacted subject identifiers are OK.

3) Results of the most recent privileged access recertification (names, roles, recertification date).

4) Keystore rotation evidence for customer data encryption keys (rotation log entries, who performed rotation, and associated ticket IDs).

Please confirm whether Redwood can: (a) provide a bridge letter covering the SOC 2 window 2026-06-01 — 2026-11-30, and (b) provide the above artifacts within 5 business days. If you require an executed NDA or a secure transfer mechanism (SFTP / pre-signed link) let us know.

If you have any constraints (PII redaction, legal review) please call them out now so we can plan testing windows.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Senior Auditor, TruHealth
elena.park@truhealth.com
[TruHealth Audit Team]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@truhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II: supplemental control artifact request

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and the audit ID. We can provide a bridge letter that covers the period 2026-06-01 through 2026-11-30 and deliver sampled artifacts as you requested. A few quick clarifying questions so we scope slices correctly:

• For the MFA logs: do you require full auth headers/PII, or should we redact user emails and provide pseudonymous user IDs? We can provide both formats but need to know redaction level for the auditor report.
• For SAML assertion traces: is a redacted JSON trace acceptable (remove assertion subject, keep assertion ID and time)?
• For privileged recert: do you need a signed PDF of the recertification report or an exported CSV?
• Keystore rotation: do you want the ticket IDs only or a copy of the rotation audit entry (redacted)?

Proposed timeline:
• Today: we’ll share a bridge letter draft and confirm transfer method.
• +2 business days: deliver sampled MFA + SAML slices (redacted per your direction).
• +3 business days: privileged recertation export + keystore rotation evidence.

We usually provide artifacts via a secure access-controlled Google Drive folder or an SFTP link; we will not publish raw logs publicly. If TruHealth needs a DPA addendum or additional NDA clause for access to raw logs, let us know.

I’m looping in Olga (Product Security) for the MFA + SAML extracts and Karthik (Identity/OT) for keystore/privileged recert. They’ll confirm what exact slices we can extract and any redaction steps.

Attached: redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf (please review and flag any language you need tightened).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:30:00Z
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II: supplemental control artifact request — tasking

Olga / Karthik —

Forwarding TruHealth's artifact ask. Quick plan / owners below: please respond with confirmations and any blockers.

• Olga: MFA log slice (owner). Extract a three-business-day consecutive window between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-08 that has representative traffic. Provide columns: pseudonymous_user_id, timestamp (UTC), method (TOTP/Push), result (success/failure), session_id, device_type. Output as CSV. Redact email addresses. Estimated time: 6 hours.
• Karthik: SAML assertion trace + keystore rotation proof. For SAML provide three assertion samples (JSON) with assertion_id, issuer, timestamp, and redacted subject (subject -> SUBJECT_REDACTED). For keystore rotation, provide rotation audit entries with ticket ID and operator id. Export as: saml_assertion_trace_20261207.json and keystore_rotation_log_20261207.pdf. Estimated time: 4 hours.
• Privileged recert: Olga to export the last recertification roster as CSV (name, role, recert_date, approver).

Notes / constraints:
• We must remove any customer PII per policy. If auditors insist on unredacted identifiers we will need a signed NDA addendum and legal sign-off.
• Access to raw auth token payloads is restricted; we can provide assertion IDs and timestamps but not raw token payloads unless TruHealth executes the access agreement.

Deliverables (internal names): authn_log_sample_20261207.csv, saml_assertion_trace_20261207.json, privileged_recert_20261207.csv, keystore_rotation_log_20261207.pdf. I will attach the bridge letter draft to the audit folder once we confirm transfer method.

Please confirm ETA and if you need me to triage with Legal for an NDA addendum.

Thanks — Mina
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@truhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II: supplemental control artifact request — delivery plan

Elena —

Appreciate the patience. Below is our delivery plan and what we'll place in the secure folder (link at the bottom).

1) Bridge letter (attached): redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf — this covers 2026-06-01 through 2026-11-30. Please review and confirm any language changes; we can finalize and produce a signed copy.

2) Artifact bundle (sampled / redacted):
   • authn_log_sample_20261207.csv — MFA slice (pseudonymous_user_id, timestamp UTC, method, result, session_id, device_type). No email addresses included.
   • saml_assertion_trace_20261207.json — three redacted assertion traces: assertion_id, issuer, timestamp, subject replaced with SUBJECT_REDACTED.
   • privileged_recert_20261207.csv — recertification roster (name, role, recert_date, approver).
   • keystore_rotation_log_20261207.pdf — rotation audit entries with ticket IDs and operator IDs (no private key material included).

3) Transfer and security: we will upload these files into a restricted Drive folder with viewer-only links for your audit addresses and SSO enforced by Redwood (preferred). If TruHealth requires SFTP instead, confirm and we’ll provision an account. Access will require acceptance of the temporary access agreement (one-click).

4) Timeline: We can have the bridge letter + MFA + SAML slices in the folder by EOD +2 business days (2026-12-14 end of day) and the remaining artifacts (privileged recert + keystore rotation) by EOD +3 business days (2026-12-15). If you need accelerated delivery, we can prioritize MFA and SAML for same-day delivery but will require confirmation on redaction level.

Link (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xample-redwood-truhealth (access controlled)

If this plan looks good, please reply with: (A) preferred transfer mechanism (Drive / SFTP) and (B) confirmation that pseudonymous IDs + redacted SAML traces meet your audit requirements. If you want a call to walk through the artifacts, Olga and Karthik are available tomorrow morning.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf, authn_log_sample_20261207.csv, saml_assertion_trace_20261207.json]
